Per-genus discrimination of each locus in the validation folds

Source: R/barcoding_report.R
summarise_barcoding_genus_discrimination.Rd

From the IdTaxa predictions of the validation folds (step 7), cut at the operating threshold of step 9 (60 by default), counts per locus, scheme and true genus the queries whose species was named correctly, the wrong species, the right and wrong genera, and the unassigned, with their rates. It says how well each locus tells the species of one genus apart in the library, which the identification report shows beside the answer.

Usage

summarise_barcoding_genus_discrimination(
  classifier_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "7_classifier"),
  threshold_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "9_threshold"),
  output_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "11_metrics"),
  idtaxa_rule = "default_60"
)

Arguments

classifier_dir

Character. Directory of step 7, with TABLE_barcoding_predictions_{species,genus}_idtaxa.csv.

threshold_dir

Character. Directory of step 9, with TABLE_barcoding_threshold_operating_idtaxa.csv.

output_dir

Character. Where TABLE_barcoding_genus_discrimination_idtaxa.csv is written.

idtaxa_rule

Character. Row of the operating table used, "default_60" by default.

Value

Invisibly, the table.

See also

summarise_barcoding_metrics(), report_barcoding_identification().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarise_barcoding_genus_discrimination()
} # }
